card.name: Word ending a drug name phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug name or product phrase in drug labels, such as 'contrast' after 'non-', 'Injection' after a drug name or 'for', and the final piece of 'Polistirex'.

modes.label: Non-contrast MRI
modes.description: The word 'contrast' right after 'non-' in MRI imaging text.
modes.example: When available, non-<<contrast>> MRI images should be reviewed during the interpretation

modes.label: Closing drug name word
modes.description: The last word of a drug name or dosage-form phrase such as Injection, sulfate or the end of Polistirex.
modes.example: Patients receiving Daptomycin for<< Injection>> should be monitored for the development of muscle
